verses.en: Now the word of the Lord came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Jonas, fils d''Amitthaï, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ አማቴ ልጅ ወደ ዮናስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ ።

verses.en: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, va à Ninive, la grande ville, et crie contre elle! car sa méchanceté est montée jusqu''à moi.
verses.am: ተነሥተህ ወደዚያች ወደ ታላቂቱ ከተማ ወደ ነነዌ ሂድ፥ ክፉታቸውም ወደ ፊቴ ወጥቶአልና በእርስዋ ላይ ስበክ።

verses.en: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord.
verses.fr: Et Jonas se leva pour s''enfuir à Tarsis, loin de la face de l''Eternel. Il descendit à Japho, et il trouva un navire qui allait à Tarsis; il paya le prix du transport, et s''embarqua pour aller avec les passagers à Tarsis, loin de la face de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ዮናስ ግን ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወደ ተርሴስ ይኰበልል ዘንድ ተነሣ፤ ወደ ኢዮጴም ወረደ፥ ወደ ተርሴስም የምታልፍ መርከብ አገኘ፤ ከእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ኰብልሎ ከእነርሱ ጋር ወደ ተርሴስ ይሄድ ዘንድ ዋጋ ሰጥቶ ወደ እርስዋ ገባ።

verses.en: But the Lord sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.
verses.fr: Mais l''Eternel fit souffler sur la mer un vent impétueux, et il s''éleva sur la mer une grande tempête. Le navire menaçait de faire naufrage.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በባሕሩ ላይ ታላቅ ነፋስን አመጣ፥ በባሕርም ላይ ታላቅ ማዕበል ሆነ፥ መርከቢቱም ልትሰበር ቀረበች።

verses.en: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.
verses.fr: Les mariniers eurent peur, ils implorèrent chacun leur dieu, et ils jetèrent dans la mer les objets qui étaient sur le navire, afin de le rendre plus léger. Jonas descendit au fond du navire, se coucha, et s''endormit profondément.
verses.am: መርከበኞቹም ፈሩ፥ እያንዳንዱም ወደ አምላኩ ጮኸ፤ መርከቢቱም እንድትቀልልላቸው በውስጥዋ የነበረውን ዕቃ ወደ ባሕር ጣሉት፤ ዮናስ ግን ወደ መርከቡ ውስጠኛው ክፍል ወርዶ ነበር፥ በከባድ እንቅልፍም ተኝቶ ነበር።

verses.en: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? arise, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.
verses.fr: Le pilote s''approcha de lui, et lui dit: Pourquoi dors-tu? Lève-toi, invoque ton Dieu! peut-être voudra-t-il penser à nous, et nous ne périrons pas.
verses.am: የመርከቡም አለቃ ወደ እርሱ ቀርቦ። ምነው ተኝተሃል? እንዳንጠፋ እግዚአብሔር ያስበን እንደ ሆነ ተነሥተህ አምላክህን ጥራ አለው።

verses.en: And they said every one to his fellow, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.
verses.fr: Et ils se dirent l''un à l''autre: Venez, et tirons au sort, pour savoir qui nous attire ce malheur. Ils tirèrent au sort, et le sort tomba sur Jonas.
verses.am: እርስ በእርሳቸውም። ይህ ክፉ ነገር በማን ምክንያት እንዳገኘን እናውቅ ዘንድ ኑ፥ ዕጣ እንጣጣል ተባባሉ። ዕጣም ተጣጣሉ፥ ዕጣውም በዮናስ ላይ ወደቀ።

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us; What is thine occupation? and whence comest thou? what is thy country? and of what people art thou?
verses.fr: Alors ils lui dirent: Dis-nous qui nous attire ce malheur. Quelles sont tes affaires, et d''où viens-tu? Quel est ton pays, et de quel peuple es-tu?
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜም። ይህ ክፉ ነገር በማን ምክንያት እንዳገኘን እባክህ ንገረን፤ ሥራህ ምንድር ነው? ከወዴትስ መጣህ? አገርህስ ወዴት ነው? ወይስ ከማን ወገን ነህ? አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, I am an Hebrew; and I fear the Lord, the God of heaven, which hath made the sea and the dry land.
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Je suis Hébreu, et je crains l''Eternel, le Dieu des cieux, qui a fait la mer et la terre.
verses.am: እርሱም። እኔ ዕብራዊ ነኝ፤ በሕሩንና የብሱን የፈጠረውን የሰማይን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን እመልካለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him. Why hast thou done this? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the Lord, because he had told them.
verses.fr: Ces hommes eurent une grande frayeur, et ils lui dirent: Pourquoi as-tu fait cela? Car ces hommes savaient qu''il fuyait loin de la face de l''Eternel, parce qu''il le leur avait déclaré.
verses.am: እነዚያም ሰዎች ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንደ ኰበለለ እርሱ ስለ ነገራቸው አውቀዋልና እጅግ ፈርተው። ይህ ያደረግኸው ምንድር ነው? አሉት።

verses.en: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous.
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent: Que te ferons-nous, pour que la mer se calme envers nous? Car la mer était de plus en plus orageuse.
verses.am: ባሕሩንም ሞገዱ አጥብቆ ያናውጠው ነበርና። ባሕሩ ከእኛ ዘንድ ጸጥ እንዲል ምን እናድርግብህ? አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Prenez-moi, et jetez-moi dans la mer, et la mer se calmera envers vous; car je sais que c''est moi qui attire sur vous cette grande tempête.
verses.am: እርሱም። ይህ ታላቅ ማዕበል በእኔ ምክንያት እንዳገኛችሁ አውቃለሁና አንሥታችሁ ወደ ባሕር ጣሉኝ፥ ባሕሩም ጸጥ ይልላችኋል አላቸው።

verses.en: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not: for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous against them.
verses.fr: Ces hommes ramaient pour gagner la terre, mais ils ne le purent, parce que la mer s''agitait toujours plus contre eux.
verses.am: ሰዎቹ ግን ወደ ምድሩ ሊመለሱ አጥብቀው ቀዘፉ፤ ዳሩ ግን ባሕሩ እጅግ አብዝቶ ይናወጥባቸው ነበርና አልቻሉም።

verses.en: Wherefore they cried unto the Lord, and said, We beseech thee, O Lord, we beseech thee, let us not perish for this man's life, and lay not upon us innocent blood: for thou, O Lord, hast done as it pleased thee.
verses.fr: Alors ils invoquèrent l''Eternel, et dirent: O Eternel, ne nous fais pas périr à cause de la vie de cet homme, et ne nous charge pas du sang innocent! Car toi, Eternel, tu fais ce que tu veux.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸው። አቤቱ፥ እንደ ወደድህ አድርገሃልና እንለምንሃለን፤ አቤቱ፥ ስለዚህ ሰው ነፍስ እንዳንጠፋ ንጹሕም ደም በእኛ ላይ እንዳታደርግ እንለምንሃለን አሉ።

verses.en: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.
verses.fr: Puis ils prirent Jonas, et le jetèrent dans la mer. Et la fureur de la mer s''apaisa.
verses.am: ዮናስንም ወስደው ወደ ባሕሩ ጣሉት፤ ባሕሩም ከመናወጡ ጸጥ አለ።

verses.en: Then the men feared the Lord exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice unto the Lord, and made vows.
verses.fr: Ces hommes furent saisis d''une grande crainte de l''Eternel, et ils offrirent un sacrifice à l''Eternel, et firent des voeux.
verses.am: ሰዎችም እግዚአብሔርን እጅግ ፈሩ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም መሥዋዕትን አቀረቡ፥ ስእለትንም ተሳሉ።

verses.en: Now the Lord had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
verses.fr: L''Eternel fit venir un grand poisson pour engloutir Jonas, et Jonas fut dans le ventre du poisson trois jours et trois nuits.

verses.en: Then Jonah prayed unto the Lord his God out of the fish's belly,
verses.fr: Jonas, dans le ventre du poisson, pria l''Eternel, son Dieu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ዮናስን የሚውጥ ታላቅ ዓሣ አሰናዳ፤ ዮናስም ሦስት ቀንና ሦስት ሌሊት በዓሣው ሆድ ውስጥ ነበረ።

verses.en: And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the Lord, and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice.
verses.fr: Il dit: Dans ma détresse, j''ai invoqué l''Eternel, Et il m''a exaucé; Du sein du séjour des morts j''ai crié, Et tu as entendu ma voix.
verses.am: ዮናስም በዓሣው ሆድ ውስጥ ሆኖ ወደ አምላኩ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለየ፥ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods compassed me about: all thy billows and thy waves passed over me.
verses.fr: Tu m''as jeté dans l''abîme, dans le coeur de la mer, Et les courants d''eau m''ont environné; Toutes tes vagues et tous tes flots ont passé sur moi.
verses.am: በመከራዬ ሳለሁ ወደ አምላኬ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኽሁ፥ እርሱም ሰማኝ፤ በሲኦልም ሆድ ውስጥ ሆኜ ጮኽሁ፥ ቃሌንም አዳመጥህ።

verses.en: Then I said, I am cast out of thy sight; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.
verses.fr: Je disais: Je suis chassé loin de ton regard! Mais je verrai encore ton saint temple.
verses.am: ወደ ጥልቁ ወደ ባሕሩ ውስጥ ጣልኸኝ፥ ፈሳሾችም በዙሪያዬ ነበሩ፤ ማዕበልህና ሞገድህ ሁሉ በላዬ አለፉ።

verses.en: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.
verses.fr: Les eaux m''ont couvert jusqu''à m''ôter la vie, L''abîme m''a enveloppé, Les roseaux ont entouré ma tête.
verses.am: እኔም። ከዓይንህ ፊት ተጣልሁ፤ ነገር ግን ወደ ቅዱስ መቅደስህ ደግሞ እመለከታለሁ አልሁ።

verses.en: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars was about me for ever: yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption, O Lord my God.
verses.fr: Je suis descendu jusqu''aux racines des montagnes, Les barres de la terre m''enfermaient pour toujours; Mais tu m''as fait remonter vivant de la fosse, Eternel, mon Dieu!
verses.am: ውኆችም እስከ ነፍሴ ድረስ ከበቡኝ፤ ጥልቁ ባሕር በዙሪያዬ ነበረ፤ የባሕሩ ሣር በራሴ ተጠምጥሞ ነበር።

verses.en: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the Lord: and my prayer came in unto thee, into thine holy temple.
verses.fr: Quand mon âme était abattue au dedans de moi, Je me suis souvenu de l''Eternel, Et ma prière est parvenue jusqu''à toi, Dans ton saint temple.
verses.am: ወደ ተራሮች መሠረት ወረድሁ፤ በምድርና በመወርወሪያዎችዋ ለዘላለም ተዘጋሁ፤ አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ ሕይወቴን ከጕድጓዱ አወጣህ።

verses.en: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
verses.fr: Ceux qui s''attachent à de vaines idoles Eloignent d''eux la miséricorde.
verses.am: ነፍሴ በዛለችብኝ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን አሰብሁት፤ ጸሎቴም ወደ አንተ ወደ ቅዱስ መቅደስህ ገባች።

verses.en: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the Lord.
verses.fr: Pour moi, je t''offrirai des sacrifices avec un cri d''actions de grâces, J''accomplirai les voeux que j''ai faits: Le salut vient de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከንቱነትንና ሐሰትን የሚጠብቁ ምሕረታቸውን ትተዋል።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla au poisson, et le poisson vomit Jonas sur la terre.
verses.am: እኔ ግን በምስጋና ቃል እሠዋልሃለሁ፤ የተሳልሁትንም እከፍላለሁ። ደኅንነት ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto Jonah the second time, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Jonas une seconde fois, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ሁለተኛ ወደ ዮናስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, va à Ninive, la grande ville, et proclames-y la publication que je t''ordonne!
verses.am: ተነሥተህ ወደዚያች ወደ ታላቂቱ ከተማ ወደ ነነዌ ሂድ፥ የምነግርህንም ስብከት ስበክላት አለው።

verses.en: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of the Lord. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days' journey.
verses.fr: Et Jonas se leva, et alla à Ninive, selon la parole de l''Eternel. Or Ninive était une très grande ville, de trois jours de marche.
verses.am: ዮናስም ተነሥቶ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ነነዌ ሄደ፤ ነነዌም የሦስት ቀን መንገድ ያህል እጅግ ታላቅ ከተማ ነበረች።

verses.en: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.
verses.fr: Jonas fit d''abord dans la ville une journée de marche; il criait et disait: Encore quarante jours, et Ninive est détruite!
verses.am: ዮናስም የአንድ ቀን መንገድ ያህል ወደ ከተማይቱ ውስጥ ሊገባ ጀመረ፤ ጮኾም። በሦስት ቀን ውስጥ ነነዌ ትገለበጣለች አለ።

verses.en: So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
verses.fr: Les gens de Ninive crurent à Dieu, ils publièrent un jeûne, et se revêtirent de sacs, depuis les plus grands jusqu''aux plus petits.
verses.am: የነነዌም ሰዎች እግዚአብሔርን አመኑ፤ ለጾም አዋጅ ነገሩ፥ ከታላቁም ጀምሮ እስከ ታናሹ ድረስ ማቅ ለበሱ።

verses.en: For word came unto the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and he laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.
verses.fr: La chose parvint au roi de Ninive; il se leva de son trône, ôta son manteau, se couvrit d''un sac, et s''assit sur la cendre.
verses.am: ወሬውም ወደ ነነዌ ንጉሥ ደረሰ፤ እርሱም ከዙፋኑ ተነሥቶ መጐናጸፊያውን አወለቀ ማቅም ለበሰ፥ በአመድም ላይ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing: let them not feed, nor drink water:
verses.fr: Et il fit faire dans Ninive cette publication, par ordre du roi et de ses grands; Que les hommes et les bêtes, les boeufs et les brebis, ne goûtent de rien, ne paissent point, et ne boivent point d''eau!
verses.am: አዋጅም አስነገረ፥ በነነዌም ውስጥ የንጉሡንና የመኳንንቱን ትእዛዝ አሳወጀ፥ እንዲህም አለ። ሰዎችና እንስሶች ላሞችና በጎች አንዳችን አይቅመሱ፤ አይሰማሩም ውኃንም አይጠጡ፤

verses.en: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily unto God: yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that is in their hands.
verses.fr: Que les hommes et les bêtes soient couverts de sacs, qu''ils crient à Dieu avec force, et qu''ils reviennent tous de leur mauvaise voie et des actes de violence dont leurs mains sont coupables!
verses.am: ሰዎችና እንስሶችም በማቅ ይከደኑ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም በብርቱ ይጩኹ፤ ሰዎችም ሁሉ ከክፉ መንገዳቸውና በእጃቸው ካለው ግፍ ይመለሱ።

verses.en: Who can tell if God will turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?
verses.fr: Qui sait si Dieu ne reviendra pas et ne se repentira pas, et s''il ne renoncera pas à son ardente colère, en sorte que nous ne périssions point?
verses.am: እኛ እንዳንጠፋ እግዚአብሔር ተመልሶ ይጸጸት እንደ ሆነ፥ ከጽኑ ቍጣውም ይመለስ እንደ ሆነ ማን ያውቃል?

verses.en: And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God repented of the evil, that he had said that he would do unto them; and he did it not.
verses.fr: Dieu vit qu''ils agissaient ainsi et qu''ils revenaient de leur mauvaise voie. Alors Dieu se repentit du mal qu''il avait résolu de leur faire, et il ne le fit pas.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከክፉ መንገዳቸው እንደተመለሱ ሥራቸውን አየ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ያደርግባቸው ዘንድ በተናገረው ክፉ ነገር ተጸጽቶ አላደረገውም።

verses.en: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.
verses.fr: Cela déplut fort à Jonas, et il fut irrité.
verses.am: ይህም ዮናስን ከቶ ደስ አላሰኘውም፥ እርሱም ተቈጣ።

verses.en: And he prayed unto the Lord, and said, I pray thee, O Lord, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou art a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.
verses.fr: Il implora l''Eternel, et il dit: Ah! Eternel, n''est-ce pas ce que je disais quand j''étais encore dans mon pays? C''est ce que je voulais prévenir en fuyant à Tarsis. Car je savais que tu es un Dieu compatissant et miséricordieux, lent à la colère et riche en bonté, et qui te repens du mal.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጸለየና። አቤቱ፥ እለምንሃለሁ፤ በአገሬ ሳለሁ የተናገርሁት ይህ አልነበረምን? አንተ ቸርና ይቅር ባይ፥ ታጋሽም፥ ምሕረትህም የበዛ፥ ከክፉው ነገርም የተነሣ የምትጸጸት አምላክ እንደ ሆንህ አውቄ ነበርና ስለዚህ ወደ ተርሴስ ለመኰብለል ፈጥኜ ነበር።

verses.en: Therefore now, O Lord, take, I beseech thee, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.
verses.fr: Maintenant, Eternel, prends-moi donc la vie, car la mort m''est préférable à la vie.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ፥ ከሕይወት ሞት ይሻለኛልና እባክህ፥ ነፍሴን ከእኔ ውሰድ አለው።

verses.en: Then said the Lord, Doest thou well to be angry?
verses.fr: L''Eternel répondit: Fais-tu bien de t''irriter?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። በውኑ ትቈጣ ዘንድ ይገባሃልን? አለ።

verses.en: So Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.
verses.fr: Et Jonas sortit de la ville, et s''assit à l''orient de la ville, Là il se fit une cabane, et s''y tint à l''ombre, jusqu''à ce qu''il vît ce qui arriverait dans la ville.
verses.am: ዮናስም ከከተማይቱ ወጣ፥ ከከተማይቱም በስተ ምሥራቅ በኩል ተቀመጠ፤ ከተማይቱንም የሚያገኛትን እስኪያይ ድረስ በዚያ ለራሱ ዳስ ሠርቶ ከጥላው በታች ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And the Lord God prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd.
verses.fr: L''Eternel Dieu fit croître un ricin, qui s''éleva au-dessus de Jonas, pour donner de l''ombre sur sa tête et pour lui ôter son irritation. Jonas éprouva une grande joie à cause de ce ricin.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም ቅል አዘጋጀ፥ ከጭንቀቱም ታድነው ዘንድ በራሱ ላይ ጥላ እንድትሆን በዮናስ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ አደረጋት፤ ዮናስም ስለ ቅሊቱ እጅግ ደስ አለው።

verses.en: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.
verses.fr: Mais le lendemain, à l''aurore, Dieu fit venir un ver qui piqua le ricin, et le ricin sécha.
verses.am: በነጋው ግን ወገግ ባለ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ትልን አዘጋጀ፥ እርስዋም ቅሊቱን እስክትደርቅ ድረስ መታቻት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.
verses.fr: Au lever du soleil, Dieu fit souffler un vent chaud d''orient, et le soleil frappa la tête de Jonas, au point qu''il tomba en défaillance. Il demanda la mort, et dit: La mort m''est préférable à la vie.
verses.am: ፀሐይም በወጣች ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ትኩስ የምሥራቅ ነፋስ አዘጋጀ ዮናስ እስኪዝል ድረስም ፀሐይ ራሱን መታው፤ ለራሱም ሞትን ፈለገና። ከሕይወት ሞት ይሻለኛል አለ።

verses.en: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.
verses.fr: Dieu dit à Jonas: Fais-tu bien de t''irriter à cause du ricin? Il répondit: Je fais bien de m''irriter jusqu''à la mort.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ዮናስን። በውኑ ስለዚች ቅል ትቈጣ ዘንድ ይገባሃልን? አለው። እርሱም። እስከ ሞት ድረስ እቈጣ ዘንድ ይገባኛል አለ።

verses.en: Then said the Lord, Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit: Tu as pitié du ricin qui ne t''a coûté aucune peine et que tu n''as pas fait croître, qui est né dans une nuit et qui a péri dans une nuit.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። አንተ ትበቅል ዘንድ ላልደከምህባት ላላሳደግሃትም፥ በአንድ ሌሊት ለበቀለች፥ በአንድ ሌሊትም ለደረቀችው ቅል አዝነሃል።

verses.en: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?
verses.fr: Et moi, je n''aurais pas pitié de Ninive, la grande ville, dans laquelle se trouvent plus de cent vingt mille hommes qui ne savent pas distinguer leur droite de leur gauche, et des animaux en grand nombre!
verses.am: እኔስ ቀኛቸውንና ግራቸውን የማይለዩ ከመቶ ሀያ ሺህ የሚበልጡ ሰዎችና ብዙ እንስሶች ላሉባት ለታላቂቱ ከተማ ለነነዌ አላዝንምን? አለው።
